objective: Complete the remaining R1-R9 architecture work on the 0.4 development line without weakening released compatibility, scientific behavior, or qualification contracts.

execution_policy.threshold_rule: Do not relax a numerical, scientific, performance, memory, restart, or packaging threshold and do not add skip or xfail.
execution_policy.s16_s17_numerical_rule: Numerical outputs must remain byte-identical to v0.3.0 and these steps do not run H100 qualification.
execution_policy.gpu_path_rule: If S-16 or S-17 must change a GPU-only path, stop and move that work into S-19 before implementation.
execution_policy.s18_numerical_rule: S-18 should remain byte-identical; any unavoidable difference requires a pre-registered tolerance, a scientific explanation, and a separate user decision before implementation.
execution_policy.s19_budget: One pre-registered H100 qualification campaign at S-09 scale; after a qualification failure, at most one separately authorized diagnostic job.
execution_policy.d0013_exception: The bounded v0.3.0 D-0013 memory exception does not extend to v0.4.0.

completion_gates.title: Scope and registry closure
completion_gates.criterion: Every S-16 through S-18 item is independently verified, accepted by a confirmed decision, or explicitly deferred by a confirmed decision; no untriaged finding remains.

completion_gates.title: Internal sharing without public drift
completion_gates.criterion: R7 and R9 helper and import-boundary cleanup is complete, public interfaces are unchanged unless pre-authorized in S-17, and S-16 outputs are byte-identical to v0.3.0.

completion_gates.title: Qualification infrastructure and evidence retention
completion_gates.criterion: R8 uses the user-confirmed evidence-retention policy, preserves immutable historical records, and makes a fresh GitHub clone independently testable without skip or xfail.

completion_gates.title: Control and public-surface interoperability
completion_gates.criterion: PSSolver-Control main is independently qualified against v0.3.0 before R3/R6 work; S-17 preserves byte-identical numerical outputs and follows separately confirmed deprecation and experimental-surface decisions.

completion_gates.title: Released checkpoint compatibility
completion_gates.criterion: Every released v0.2.x and v0.3.0 checkpoint fixture remains readable without source mutation and passes the registered restart-equivalence gates.

completion_gates.title: Numerical and scientific non-regression
completion_gates.criterion: S-16 and S-17 are byte-identical to v0.3.0; S-18 is byte-identical unless a tolerance is registered and approved before implementation; no numerical or scientific threshold is relaxed.

completion_gates.title: CPU, packaging, and public import closure
completion_gates.criterion: Clean-source and installed-wheel CPU suites pass in the registered environments; packaging, public imports, console entry points, documentation bindings, and provider identities are verified without new skip or xfail.

completion_gates.title: Consolidated GPU/H100 qualification
completion_gates.criterion: One pre-registered S-09-scale campaign covers the S-18 numerical paths and any authorized GPU-path change, using v0.3.0 as baseline and the accepted thresholds without the D-0013 memory exception; a failure permits at most one separately authorized diagnostic job.

completion_gates.title: Independent candidate, release, and post-release acceptance
completion_gates.criterion: The v0.4.0 candidate, assets, online release, and post-release state pass independent read-only acceptance before the line is declared complete.
